name: Patek Philippe
description: Prestigious Swiss watchmaker that successfully pivoted toward brand-centric strategy.

edges.quote: In 1968 (that year again) Patek Philippe launched a new watch that shifted the center of gravity of case design... The result was a striking new model called the Golden Ellipse.
To encourage them, Patek did something that none of the holy trinity had done much of before: brand advertising.
Encouraged by the success of the Royal Oak, Patek Philippe commissioned Gérald Genta in 1974 to design a similar watch for them.
It was called the Nautilus, and it launched at the Basel Watch Fair in 1976.
